replacementNotice: This email replaces any earlier email for the same request. Use the link in the newest one; earlier links for this request no longer work.
title: Campaigns
help: Send onboarding or card update links to households and follow their progress.
name: Campaign name
expiryHelp: Choose a date within {expiryDays} days. Links expire at the end of that day in
daysHelp: Up to {reminders} days after creation (1–{reminderDay}), in increasing order, separated by commas (for example 3, 7). Reminders run within the hour after 9 am in the gym timezone, before link expiry. Leave blank for no automatic reminders.
cardError: Could not check saved cards. Turn the filter off and on to retry.
selectionHelp: Filters change the visible list. Selected households stay selected. Choose up to {recipients} households.
sendHelp: Initial sends are queued immediately while member emails are enabled. Email preferences still apply. Automatic Stripe matching uses only customers already tagged for this gym; untagged customers are not matched. Unmatched households get a customer when their link opens.
nameLimit: Use a campaign name of {name} characters or fewer.
scheduleLimit: Choose no more than {reminders} reminder days.
dayLimit: Each reminder day must be {reminderDay} or less.
expiryLimit: Choose an expiry within {expiryDays} days of now, including the end of that day in the gym timezone.
limits: Check the campaign limits: a name up to {name} characters, up to {recipients} households, up to {reminders} increasing reminder days from 1 to {reminderDay}, and a future expiry within {expiryDays} days.
customerMatchHeld: Customer matching is on hold because household details changed after a customer creation attempt. Review the household's payment setup before asking them to update their card.
invalid: Enter a name, expiry date, increasing positive reminder days, and at least one household.
saveError: The request failed. Refresh the campaign list before trying again.
remindHelp: Scheduled and manual sends share a limit of one attempt per link each gym-local day. A suppressed reminder, or one without a payment link, keeps the earlier link working; otherwise use the newest email. Expiry stays the same. Completed, revoked and expired links receive no reminders.
created: Campaign created. Delivery starts while member emails are enabled.
noAccess: You do not have access to campaigns.
householdsError: Households could not be loaded. Try again to select recipients and see their names.
